clusters.mechanism: Calls still awaiting results are skipped by live counting until finish(), so six identical unresolved calls never trigger loop detection while the invocation runs.
Unresolved calls are evicted from the window before finish() can count them, so the repetition is lost and never detected.
An unresolved entry blocks counting of every later call with the same key, so completed identical calls are not counted until that entry leaves the window or the invocation finishes.
